extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers (novelists and short-story authors) seeking to create deep, believable characters
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for developing fully realized, compelling characters whose psychology, voice, choices, and sensory life drive plot and engage readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master the 'Believe, Care, Invest' Trifecta
rubrics_metrics.description: Readers must believe character is real, care about circumstances, invest in their problem-solving ability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create believable, specific details to establish verisimilitude; evoke empathy for the character's situation; show their capacity to act and solve problems so readers stay invested in outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define the Dramatic Question
rubrics_metrics.description: "Who are you when the chips are down?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish a clear, central dramatic question or dilemma that frames stakes and reveals character under pressure; use it to shape choices and arc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Absolute Specificity
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace vague traits with precise, measurable details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer concrete, observable characteristics and behaviors over abstract labels; specific details make characters memorable and believable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand the Heroine's Journey
rubrics_metrics.description: Strength can come through connection and delegation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize alternative arc structures (e.g., relational growth, collaboration) rather than only individualistic 'hero' triumphs; let character growth include building bonds and sharing power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign Metaphor Families
rubrics_metrics.description: Each character draws from a distinctive linguistic well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a consistent set of metaphors, images, and associative language for each character to reinforce voice and thematic coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find the Diagnostic Detail
rubrics_metrics.description: One hyper-specific behavioral quirk pulled from real life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a single, well-chosen small detail or habit that signals broader personality and makes the character feel lived-in and unique.

rubrics_metrics.name: Displace Your Own Trauma
rubrics_metrics.description: Channel personal pain into emotionally parallel struggles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use personal emotional truth as fuel for fiction while transforming specifics so the story stands on its own and avoids exposing or exploiting real people.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write Diverse Characters as Real People
rubrics_metrics.description: Various backgrounds in normal contemporary roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray diversity through ordinary, fully rounded lives rather than stereotypes or token moments; treat culture as one facet among many in a character's life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect Tribal and Cultural Specificity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research and represent cultural and communal differences with nuance and specificity; avoid broad generalizations and flattened portrayals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Give Protagonists Morally Neutral Hero Status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize agency and interesting decision-making over making protagonists simply likable; moral ambiguity can increase engagement if actions and motives are clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build Vibrant Side Characters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make supporting characters distinct, active, and three-dimensional so they contribute to the story world and could plausibly anchor their own narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Voice as a Rhythmic Tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Sentence structure (periods vs. commas) reflects psychology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shape narration and dialogue rhythm to mirror a character's mental and emotional states—short choppy sentences for urgency, flowing sentences for ease—so voice conveys interiority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link Character and Plot Inseparably
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot tests and exposes protagonist's particular flaw repeatedly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design plot events to force the protagonist into choices that reveal and escalate their central flaw or need, ensuring character growth is integral to story movement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write Out of Order (Discovery Writing)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow yourself to write the most vivid or revealing scenes when they come, then structure and connect them afterward—use discovery writing to surface character truths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Research for Sensory Details
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ground scenes in researched sensory detail gathered from travel, observation, and immersion to make settings and experiences feel authentic and vivid.
